subject: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@zendesk.com>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@intercom.io>, Ava Li <ava.li@gainsight.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to participate in our rapid sourcing sprint. Attached is our short RFP (CX-RFP-Redwood-2026.pdf) — we're comparing Zendesk, Intercom, and Gainsight for customer support + success consolidation. Key objectives: reduce per-ticket cost, unify reporting, and preserve SSO/data controls.

Ask: 1) Please confirm you can respond to the attached RFP by EOD Friday (Aug 14). 2) Provide a pricing baseline for a mid-market configuration (~200 agents, ~150k monthly messages). 3) Share a short slide or doc with integration (Salesforce, product telemetry) requirements.

We expect a 2-week decision window after responses; we'll run 2-week pilots (one vendor at a time) if costs and security check out. Monica — can you coordinate pilot windows? Lauren — I'll need legal sign-off notes from you on SAML/KMS/retention.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CX-RFP-Redwood-2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@zendesk.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zendesk.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Hi Sergio — appreciate the RFP. Zendesk can absolutely respond by Aug 14; I attached a short response doc and a proposed pricing snapshot for the configuration you mentioned. Highlights: enterprise SSO + SCIM, region-based data residency options, and an SLA addendum for priority customers.

We can spin up a 14-day trial environment within 48 hours of a signed pilot SOA. For integrations, our professional services team will handle Salesforce mapping and can enable product event ingestion via a lightweight webhook or Segment.

Also including a stub of SOC 2 attestation and our standard procurement contacts.

- Jessica
Jessica Park
Senior Strategic Sales Engineer, Zendesk

Attachments: zendesk-response-aug2026.pdf (application/pdf); zendesk-soc2-stub.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Thanks, Jessica — and thanks Sergio for putting this together. Monica — please block pilot windows on the calendar once vendors confirm trial environments. Priorities for the evaluation panel: 1) cost per ticket projection, 2) migration effort (Zendesk tickets -> new system), 3) observability (per-route latency and ingest limits), and 4) security controls (SAML, KMS/HSM integrations, audit log retention).

Dylan — please review the Zendesk SOC excerpt and flag any hard blockers (data retention, exportability) by EOD Thu (Aug 13).

I'll prepare a one-page decision rubric for Friday's review.

-Lauren
Director, Customer Ops
From: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@intercom.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Hi Sergio — great to see the RFP. Intercom can deliver a demo and a 14-day trial workspace; pricing attached (seat-based and an alternative messaging volume plan). For your scale, the messaging plan tends to be more predictable on tokens/messages, but we can provide a blended quote.

Notes: Intercom's product inbox is strong for in-app support; for success workflows we recommend combining Inbox + Custom Bots + Data Warehouse sync (we included recommended connectors). Security: SAML + SCIM supported; enterprise-grade retention controls available.

Link to trial signup (trial env will be provisioned after NDA): https://try.intercom.io/redwood-trial (demo credentials sent separately).

- Mateo
Mateo Ruiz
Enterprise Sales, Intercom

Attachments: intercom-pricing-aug2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ava Li <ava.li@gainsight.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Sergio/Team — thanks for the invite. Gainsight is a bit different (success ops + playbooks) and may look heavier as a replacement for raw ticketing; however, for renewal/expansion motions and health scoring it offers strong value.

We've included a recommended architecture for integrating product telemetry, Salesforce contacts, and support backlog syncing. Timeline: 2-week planning -> 6-8 week implementation for the baseline (SFDC + 1 product integration). Pricing attached (subscription + implementation estimate). Also included reference contact in case you'd like a call with a similar customer.

- Ava
Ava Li
Solutions Engineering, Gainsight

Attachments: gainsight-proposal-aug2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CX platform sourcing sprint: Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight evaluation

Thanks everyone — good set of responses. Quick summary from the panel prep:

- Zendesk: fastest migration path for existing ticket history, strong SLA addendum, multiple residency options.
- Intercom: best for in-app messaging and lower per-message unit cost if we pick the messaging plan; trial link provided.
- Gainsight: oriented toward success playbooks and health scoring, higher implementation lift but strong for expansion motions.

Immediate asks: Monica, please consolidate the pricing matrix (pricing-matrix.xlsx) and vendor feature matrix into a single sheet by Tues Aug 18 COB. Dylan — one more pass on legal SAML/export clauses and a redline suggestion for the Zendesk SLA. Lauren — can you run the decision rubric at our review meeting on Thu Aug 20 11:00am PT? I'll invite the vendors for short demos later that week if we move to pilots.

If any vendor can share a short reference call (30m) with a mid-market customer who consolidated support in the last 12 months, that would help our risk score.

Thanks — Sergio
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference
